        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))

os.makedirs(d,exist_ok=True)
def transform(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    sep=max(((c,sum(r.count(c) for r in g)),c) for c in set(x for r in g for x in r))[1] if False else None
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(x for r in g for x in r)
    # separator color: forms full lines
    sep=next(c for c in cnt if any(all(x==c for x in row) for row in g))
    rlines=[i for i in range(H) if all(x==sep for x in g[i])]
    clines=[j for j in range(W) if all(g[i][j]==sep for i in range(H))]
    def groups(n,lines):
        out=[];s=0
        for l in lines+[n]:
            if l>s: out.append(list(range(s,l)))
            s=l+1
        return out
    R=groups(H,rlines);C=groups(W,clines)
    mc=sorted(cnt.items(), key=lambda kv:kv[1])
    marker=mc[0][0]; bg=max(cnt,key=cnt.get) if False else mc[1][0]
    # bg = most common non-separator
    bg=sorted(cnt.items(),key=lambda kv:-kv[1])
    bg=[c for c,_ in bg if c!=sep][0]
    out=[[1 if sum(g[i][j]==marker for i in rr for j in cc)>=2 else bg for cc in C] for rr in R]
    return out
